title: AI Conversation
description: Continue talking with your character. Conversation history, behavior, and context are saved to your account.

history.title: Conversation history
history.emptyDescription: Create a new conversation to start talking with the current character.
history.archiveDescription: “{title}” will be hidden from active history. Its content is not permanently deleted.

greeting: 你好，我是{name}。I am in “{mode}” mode. Start in Chinese or tell me your goal for this practice session.

runtime.label: AI runtime
runtime.empty: No active personal API key. History remains readable, but you need to add a key before sending a new message.
runtime.description: Automatic mode uses only the highest-priority active personal key. Choosing a specific key sends the request only through that key.
runtime.loadError: Could not load personal API keys. Check the runtime again before sending a new message.

health.missingSystemKey: No active personal AI API key is available.
health.invalidKey: The API key is no longer valid or the provider is rejecting it.
health.quotaExhausted: The API key is valid but its quota is exhausted or it is currently rate limited.
health.keyUnavailable: No usable API key is available for conversation. Add a new key or choose another one.
health.providerUnavailable: The provider or secure API-key storage is currently unavailable. Try again later.
health.networkError: Could not check the AI runtime because of a network error.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: 例如：今天下班以后我想练习聊日常生活。
message.hint: Ctrl/Cmd + Enter to send · The current conversation is saved to your account.

setup.title: Conversation setup
setup.description: Choose the conversation mode, correction intensity, and reply behavior for this conversation. Your learner level is stored on your account and used for subsequent turns.
setup.interestsPlaceholder: Example: life in China, films, work, eating out, travel…
setup.characterNotesPlaceholder: Example: speak like a peer and occasionally use common colloquial expressions without overusing slang.
setup.memoryNotesDescription: This is sent again on every turn so core learner context survives long conversations.
setup.memoryNotesPlaceholder: Example: I am around HSK4, struggle with word order and Vietnamese → Chinese translation, and prefer Mainland Mandarin usage.
